result.title: Explaining Basketball Shot Classifications with Grad-CAM: An Investigation of Shortcut Reliance with Spatiotemporal Correlations
result.comment: 2 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/spicybigmac/basketball
result.summary: Basketball action recognition is used in high-stakes scenarios to inform such tasks as specialized coaching, yet the evidence used by its deep-learning models is poorly understood. This paper investigates whether there is evidence that an R(2+1)D-18 model trained on the Basketball-51 dataset relies on spurious spatiotemporal correlations when classifying basketball shot outcomes. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) was used to generate spatiotemporal saliency maps, whose faithfulness was evaluated by progressively blurring the most salient pixels. Twenty saliency maps were then visually reviewed for recurring salient regions. Grad-CAM highlighted spatially central regions of clips including the shooter, net, and occasionally the courtside crowd. Blurring interventions were conducted to support these patterns. Blurring the central region resulted in an accuracy of 43.7%, compared to the original test accuracy of 69.3% and random-blurred accuracy of 50.9%. The additional 7.2 percentage-point reduction from central blurring compared to random blurring suggests that the model relies on task-relevant visual regions; this highlights the need for continual audits to ensure trustworthy, equitable sports analytics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文用 Grad-CAM 为 Basketball-51 上投篮结果分类的 R(2+1)D-18 模型生成时空显著性图，并通过渐进模糊最显著区域（与随机模糊对照）检验显著性图的忠实性，审计模型是否依赖虚假时空相关性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「遮除显著区域相对随机遮除的额外精度落差」这一干预式忠实性检验，可能为判断 LVR 内部状态是否因果依赖任务相关视觉证据提供核查思路，但任务领域较远，需核查干预设计与归因方法是否可迁移。
